Days of inventory are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier. Days sales outstanding are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, still below fiscal 2024's {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. Within the year, quarterly days sales outstanding peaked at {trend_table.quarters-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of the filled quarters. Inventory rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} and receivables by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, while payables rose only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}. Suppliers are paid long before inventory is sold and collected, and management says it orders ahead of lead times and pays deposits and premiums for supply. The cash-flow statement's inventory line and the balance-sheet change differ by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}; the year's write-down was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}. Asset turnover is {ratios.efficiency.asset_turnover}, on average assets that blend a much smaller year-earlier balance sheet with the year-end one. Management calls the build working capital needed for future growth. On the filed numbers, the business ties up cash for longer than it did a year earlier.

liquidity.reading: The balance-sheet ratios look ample: current ratio {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio}, quick ratio {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio}, on current assets of {terms.balances_now.current_assets}, of which inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} and receivables {terms.balances_now.receivables}. The cash flow does not look ample. Operating cash flow was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} and simple free cash flow {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}. Because free cash flow is negative, the calculator computes a cash runway: {ratios.liquidity.cash_runway_months} months on cash and short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now}. The fourth quarter alone generated {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} of operating cash after {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter.inputs.before} in the third, so the full-year runway is the cautious reading, not the latest one. Cash rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash} to {terms.balances_now.cash} only because of outside money: borrowings of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued} against repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, plus a mandatory convertible preferred issue and a common stock offering. Customer advances helped, with current contract liabilities rising from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}. Against the cash stand non-cancelable purchase obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, mostly due within a year and larger than all current assets. Part of the cash sits in lender-controlled accounts, and the Taiwan subsidiary's receivables are pledged. Current liabilities of {terms.balances_now.current_liabilities} include current bank borrowings that the calculator's debt measures do not pick up, and the calculator carries no year-earlier current ratio to compare against.

The fourth quarter turned positive, a change of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter's outflow, but it was {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} against the year-earlier quarter. Income growth is strong and healthy; cash-flow growth is not. The release guides to further growth, and this analysis does not forecast it.

free_cash_flow.reading: All four measures are computed, none is missing, and all are negative. Simple free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}: operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} less capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}. Free cash flow to the firm is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}, driven by a trade working capital increase of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}. Free cash flow to equity is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity} even after net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing}; it counts debt flows only, not the preferred and common stock issued in the year. Quality-adjusted free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} after deducting share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}. No acquisition spending is recorded, and no further adjustment was applied or refused. A year earlier, operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.operating_cash_flow} covered capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}. This year's burn is working capital, not plant: capital expenditure is small beside the inventory and receivables build, though MD&A guides capital spending higher for fiscal 2027. Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct}. The trend table's year-end accruals of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} rank second highest of the filled years, behind fiscal 2024's {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, the previous year of a large working-capital build. Some terms the calculator could not fill also bear on cash. Dividends paid has no tag in any period. Share repurchases has no row for this period. Proceeds from sale of receivables has no tag in any period, which matters because the company sold receivables for the first time this year.

dupont.reading: Return on equity of {ratios.profitability.dupont.product|pct} is a net margin of {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin|pct} times an asset turnover of {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover} times an equity multiplier of {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier}. The margin leg is thin, so the other two carry the return. The company turns its average assets over more than once a year, and liabilities fund {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets|pct} of year-end assets. Of the two, the equity multiplier is the larger factor, with asset turnover close behind. This is a high-volume, low-margin assembler: its return on equity depends on moving a large balance sheet quickly and on funding part of it with other people's money. The calculator holds no year-earlier breakdown, so the movement of each leg cannot be measured. The inputs show direction only for the margin, which widened as net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} against revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Turnover is under strain from the other side: year-end assets of {terms.balances_now.assets} stand far above the year-earlier {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.assets}, swollen by inventory and receivables, and the average-based turnover blends the two. The equity in the denominator includes the newly issued mandatory convertible preferred, so the return to common holders alone is not shown.

At that pace, cash and short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now} last {ratios.liquidity.cash_runway_months} months. anomalies.name: Non-cancelable purchase obligations exceed cash and all current assets
anomalies.name_ko: 현금과 유동자산 전체를 넘어서는 취소 불가능한 구매약정
anomalies.what: Non-cancelable purchase obligations stand at {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} at year end, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, and above the figure the May 10-Q tagged for the end of March. MD&A calls them current obligations, mostly due within a year. They exceed cash of {terms.balances_now.cash} and total current assets of {terms.balances_now.current_assets}. The 10-K keeps the policy of reviewing loss liabilities on these commitments but no longer states the amount the third-quarter 10-Q had given.

anomalies.name: Cash balance funded by borrowing and stock issuance, not by operations
anomalies.name_ko: 영업이 아닌 차입과 주식 발행으로 채운 현금
anomalies.what: Cash rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash} to {terms.balances_now.cash} although simple free cash flow was {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}. The difference came from outside: borrowings of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued} against repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, plus a mandatory convertible preferred issue and a common stock offering whose net proceeds the release prints in its financing section. A new at-the-market common stock programme is set to start selling no earlier than the third calendar quarter of 2026. Even after net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing}, free cash flow to equity is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity}.

anomalies.name: Cash and receivables partly controlled by or pledged to lenders
anomalies.name_ko: 대주에게 통제되거나 담보로 잡힌 현금과 매출채권
anomalies.what: Liquidity is less free than the balances suggest. The restricted cash policy now says the balance is mostly cash in lender-controlled accounts. The JP Morgan revolver is secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all assets of the loan parties outside investment-grade periods. All receivables of the Taiwan subsidiary are pledged under the CTBC revolver. The company also used its receivables purchase agreement for the first time this year. The calculator's proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables term is missing because no tag carries it, so this financing does not appear in any computed cash flow measure. Receivables at year end are {terms.balances_now.receivables} and cash {terms.balances_now.cash}.

anomalies.name: Component supply constraints and buying ahead of lead times
anomalies.name_ko: 부품 공급 제약과 리드타임을 앞선 선매입
anomalies.what: MD&A reports industry supply constraints in memory, storage, GPUs and CPUs that affected delivery timing and pricing. The inventory estimate text says the company places non-cancellable orders ahead of its historical lead times and pays premiums and deposits to secure supply. That fits the year-end inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} and purchase obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}. The auditor names inventory valuation a critical audit matter, centred on excess and obsolescence write-down percentages.

anomalies.name: Internal control over financial reporting still not effective
anomalies.what: Internal control over financial reporting is again not effective. One IT general controls weakness remains, where controls "did not operate for a sufficient period of time". The auditor gives an adverse opinion on internal control, disclosure controls are concluded not effective, and remediation is expected only after testing during fiscal 2027. The other weaknesses reported for fiscal 2025 are stated as remediated. The remaining weakness keeps remediation and investigation costs and scrutiny elevated.

anomalies.name: Higher effective tax rate and a tax incentive assumed before approval
anomalies.name_ko: 실효세율 상승과 승인 전에 반영된 세제 혜택
anomalies.what: The effective tax rate for the year is {tax_rate|pct}, up from the prior year according to the release's reconciliation. MD&A says it rose because a lower stock price cut stock-compensation deductions and research credits. The rate also assumes a Malaysian tax exemption that the company has applied for but not yet received, and that depends on an investment threshold being met by December 2026. MD&A says the rate and cash taxes would rise if the exemption is not granted.

The year-end figure sits below fiscal 2024's {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, so the level is not unprecedented for this company, but the direction is adverse.

anomalies.what: Days payables outstanding are {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}, against days sales of inventory of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} and days sales outstanding of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. The cash conversion cycle is therefore {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle} days: suppliers are paid long before the inventory is sold and collected. Payables rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} while inventory rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, and the company also pays deposits and premiums to secure supply. The calculator carries no prior-year cycle, so the change in the cycle itself cannot be shown.

anomalies.name: Covenant-test waiver, repayment extension and a tightening leverage covenant
anomalies.name_ko: 약정 검증 면제, 상환 연장, 강화되는 레버리지 약정
anomalies.what: Lenders have had to bend terms. E.SUN granted a waiver: "A one-time waiver was granted by E.SUN Bank for the verification of the debt-to-net worth and interest coverage ratios for the period ending October 31, 2026". CTBC's revolver came due after year end, and "On July 23, 2026, the repayment date was extended to January 22, 2027". The JP Morgan revolver has a net leverage covenant that steps down over time, and a first-priority lien outside investment-grade periods. EBITDA is {ratios.solvency.ebitda}, but the calculator cannot see the debt, so it cannot compute the leverage the covenant measures.

anomalies.name: Operating cash flow reversed while earnings grew
anomalies.what: Net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and operating income {ratios.growth.operating_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Operating cash flow went from {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.operating_cash_flow} to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, a change of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, and the smoothness measure of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness} shows net income moving far less than cash. The fourth quarter's positive cash flow was still {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} against the same quarter a year earlier. The filed history also shows operating cash outflows in fiscal 2022 and fiscal 2024, both years of rapid growth, so at this company fast growth has repeatedly come with operating cash outflows.
